text: So the question is, never was it really them. The question is how they appeared. Think back to last night or to the last time. Do not force it. The image comes on its own.
If they were silent and simply present, saying nothing, nothing is wrong. That is memory settling, longing, taking a shape you can hold. If they spoke to you and you cannot remember the words,
you already know what they would have said. You are not ready to say it back yet. If they appeared young again, healthy, before the illness, that is you letting go of the last image, the hardest one.
When you wake from a dream like this, do one thing. Stay still. Do not reach for your phone. Give it 30 seconds of silence. Say their name out loud once.
I spent over 40 years learning that in silence. Everything I know is inside the quiet between thoughts. The link is in my profile.
Someone who truly loved you does not disappear completely. They stay in the only room that still has space for them.
Write their name in the comments. Just the name. Nothing else.
